roadmap.title: Hard campaign and route-locked actions
roadmap.description: Start on Hard, collect everything in each Part, take both Junction outcomes with Restart from Last Checkpoint, and let the specified presentation, episode, and story scenes finish.

roadmap.title: Timeline and cumulative cleanup
roadmap.description: Use Timeline rather than New Game to fill remaining collectible counters, buy every power upgrade, and finish any combat counters.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies with a single Time Blast.
achievements.summary: Kill three enemies with one charged @mechanic{Time Blast}.

guide.context: Act 2, Part 1 places three soldiers together just inside an industrial building, providing a reliable scripted group.

steps.text: In Act 2, Part 1, enter the early industrial building and crouch behind the box on the left when three soldiers gather ahead.
Fully charge @mechanic{Time Blast}, aim at the center soldier, and release it while all three enemies remain inside the blast radius.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with a head shot while using Dodge Focus.
achievements.summary: Land ten killing headshots during @mechanic{Dodge Focus} slow motion.

guide.context: Unhelmeted enemies usually die to one Heavy Pistol headshot; armored targets should be weakened before the focused dodge.

steps.text: Equip the Heavy Pistol and weaken any helmeted enemy with a body shot without killing the target.
Time Dodge toward the enemy, aim during the resulting Dodge Focus slowdown, and land the killing headshot; complete ten such kills.

achievements.displayName: One Foot in Front of Another
achievements.description: Traverse a total of 100 meters using the Time Rush.
achievements.summary: Travel a cumulative 100 meters with @mechanic{Time Rush}.

guide.context: The distance accumulates across separate activations after Time Rush becomes available in Act 3.

steps.text: Hold Time Rush along safe corridors or between combat groups whenever the power recharges until the cumulative distance reaches 100 meters.

achievements.description: Use Time Stop to stack a total of 1000 bullets.
achievements.summary: Fire a cumulative 1,000 bullets into enemies held by @mechanic{Time Stop}.

guide.context: Bullets suspended in a Time Stop field count toward the total; late-game Light Machine Guns build the counter quickly.

steps.text: Cast Time Stop on a durable enemy so the target remains enclosed in the time bubble.
Fire a full automatic magazine into the stopped target before the bubble collapses, then repeat until 1,000 bullets have been stacked.

achievements.description: Time Stop one hour's worth of accumulated time.
achievements.summary: Accumulate one hour of active @mechanic{Time Stop} across all casts.

guide.context: The duration is cumulative across the save, so ordinary combat use continues advancing the counter.

steps.text: Cast Time Stop during every combat encounter and allow each field to run for its full duration until the accumulated active time reaches one hour.

achievements.description: Destroy 15 enemy chronon harnesses.
achievements.summary: Destroy the back-mounted chronon harnesses on 15 Monarch soldiers.

guide.context: Harness-equipped enemies appear from Act 2 onward; destroying the glowing backpack also deals heavy damage to its wearer.

steps.text: Use Time Vision to identify a soldier's bright chronon backpack, circle behind the enemy, and shoot the harness until it explodes.
Destroy 15 separate enemy harnesses across campaign encounters or Timeline replays.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies with environmental explosions.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies with explosions from environmental objects.

guide.context: Time Vision outlines explosive barrels and other volatile scenery, and enemies can be drawn beside them before detonation.

steps.text: Use cover and movement to keep one or more enemies beside a volatile object highlighted by Time Vision.
Shoot the environmental explosive and ensure the blast lands the killing blow; accumulate 15 kills.

achievements.displayName: Hold on to Your Hope and Burn
achievements.description: Complete Act 1 of Quantum Break.
achievements.summary: Complete Act 1 of Quantum Break.

guide.context: Act 1 contains three gameplay Parts followed by Junction 1 and the first live-action episode.

steps.text: Finish Act 1, Parts 1–3, make the required Junction 1 decision, and continue until the Act 1 completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Complete Act 2 of Quantum Break.
achievements.summary: Complete Act 2 of Quantum Break.

guide.context: Act 2 contains three gameplay Parts and Junction 2 before the next episode.

steps.text: Finish Act 2, Parts 1–3, make the required Junction 2 decision, and continue until the Act 2 completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Complete Act 3 of Quantum Break.
achievements.summary: Complete Act 3 of Quantum Break.

guide.context: Act 3 contains two gameplay Parts and Junction 3; the first Part includes a heavy chronon-harness boss.

steps.text: Finish Act 3, Parts 1–2, make the required Junction 3 decision, and continue until the Act 3 completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Complete Act 4 of Quantum Break.
achievements.summary: Complete Act 4 of Quantum Break.

guide.context: Act 4 is the longest act, with four gameplay Parts and Junction 4.

steps.text: Finish Act 4, Parts 1–4, make the required Junction 4 decision, and continue until the Act 4 completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Complete Act 5 of Quantum Break.
achievements.summary: Complete Act 5 of Quantum Break.

guide.context: Act 5 has three Parts and ends with the final Paul Serene encounter.

steps.text: Finish Act 5, Parts 1–3, defeat Paul Serene, and continue through the ending until the Act 5 completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Meet Beth Wilder during Act 1.
achievements.summary: Meet Beth Wilder during the Act 1 library escape.

guide.context: The meeting is mandatory story progress after the fracture begins at Riverport University.

steps.text: Continue through Act 1 until Jack reaches the library and completes the first mandatory encounter with Beth Wilder.

achievements.description: Enter William Joyce's time machine.
achievements.summary: Enter William Joyce's time machine during Act 4.

guide.context: The trip is a mandatory Act 4 story objective after Jack and Beth prepare the machine.

steps.text: Follow the Act 4 objectives with Beth and enter William Joyce's time machine when the story prompt becomes available.

achievements.description: Recover William Joyce's Countermeasure.
achievements.summary: Recover William Joyce's Countermeasure during Act 5.

guide.context: The Countermeasure is a mandatory objective on the route through Monarch headquarters.

steps.text: Follow the Act 5 objectives through Monarch headquarters and take William Joyce's Countermeasure when Jack reaches it.

achievements.description: Witness the fracture in time.
achievements.summary: Complete the Project Promenade experiment that fractures time in Act 1.

guide.context: The experiment is the mandatory climax of Act 1, Part 1 at Riverport University.

steps.text: Follow Paul Serene into the Project Promenade laboratory and complete every experiment prompt until the fracture occurs.

achievements.description: Find William Joyce's original time machine.
achievements.summary: Find William Joyce's original time machine in Act 2, Part 3.

guide.context: The machine is inside the Bradbury Swimming Pool and is mandatory story progress.

steps.text: Continue through Act 2, Part 3, enter Bradbury Swimming Pool, and reach William Joyce's original time machine.

achievements.description: Get the chronon harness for Beth Wilder.
achievements.summary: Collect Beth Wilder's chronon harness from Office 204 in Act 3, Part 1.

guide.context: The harness is beside the Chronon Disrupted Wave Function document; leaving the office sequence without taking it requires a Timeline replay.

steps.text: During Act 3, Part 1 at the Gull Island facility, enter Office 204 on the second floor while Beth is waiting.
Pick up the chronon harness beside the document and finish the accompanying sequence before leaving the office area.

achievements.description: Hear Beth Wilder explain how she met herself.
achievements.summary: Watch Beth Wilder's mural scene in Act 4, Part 2 without skipping it.

guide.context: The achievement is tied to the story scene in which Beth explains how she met her younger self.

steps.text: In Act 4, Part 2, allow Beth's complete mural cutscene to play without using the skip command.

achievements.description: Reach William Joyce in time during Act 5.
achievements.summary: Reach William Joyce in Act 5, Part 2 and watch the full rescue scene.

guide.context: Skipping the cutscene after finding Will can prevent this unlock until the Part is replayed.

steps.text: Follow William Joyce through Act 5, Part 2 until Jack reaches him during the stutter.
Do not skip the rescue cutscene; let the full scene finish and continue until the achievement appears.

achievements.description: Choose the Hardline path at Junction 1.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Hardline} at Junction 1.

guide.context: Both Junction 1 outcomes fit one playthrough: unlock the first choice, use Restart from Last Checkpoint, then leave the preferred second choice active.

steps.text: At Junction 1, preview the outcomes and confirm @mechanic{Hardline}; wait for the achievement before opening the pause menu.
Select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}, replay the Junction, and choose PR to keep the supplied collectible route active.

achievements.description: Choose the PR path at Junction 1.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{PR} at Junction 1.

guide.context: Junction choices alter some later narrative objects, so the final active decision should match the collectible route being followed.

steps.text: Choose Hardline first, wait for its achievement, and select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}.
Replay Junction 1, preview the outcomes, and confirm @mechanic{PR} as the active decision.

achievements.description: Choose the Personal path at Junction 2.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Personal} at Junction 2.

guide.context: Restarting the checkpoint immediately after the first Junction outcome preserves the one-playthrough route.

steps.text: At Junction 2, choose Business first, wait for its achievement, and select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}.
Replay Junction 2 and confirm @mechanic{Personal} as the active decision.

achievements.description: Choose the Business path at Junction 2.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Business} at Junction 2.

guide.context: The opposite Personal outcome can be selected after an immediate checkpoint restart without beginning another playthrough.

steps.text: At Junction 2, turn around and read What Happened to Dr. Henry Kim on the desk computer, then confirm @mechanic{Business}.
After the achievement appears, select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint} and choose Personal for the active route.

achievements.description: Trust Martin Hatch at Junction 3.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Hatch} at Junction 3.

guide.context: The active Junction 3 decision affects later scenes but does not require a separate campaign run.

steps.text: At Junction 3, confirm Amaral first, wait for its achievement, and select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}.
Replay Junction 3 and confirm @mechanic{Hatch} as the active decision.

achievements.description: Trust Dr. Sofia Amaral at Junction 3.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Amaral} at Junction 3.

guide.context: An immediate checkpoint restart allows the Hatch outcome to remain active after both achievements register.

steps.text: At Junction 3, preview the outcomes and confirm @mechanic{Amaral}; wait for the achievement before pausing.
Select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}, replay Junction 3, and confirm Hatch.

achievements.description: Choose Control at Junction 4.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Control} at Junction 4.

guide.context: Junction 4 presents Control as Paul's rational outcome and Surrender as the paranoid outcome.

steps.text: At Junction 4, confirm Surrender first, wait for its achievement, and select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}.
Replay Junction 4 and confirm @mechanic{Control} as the active decision.

achievements.description: Choose Surrender at Junction 4.
achievements.summary: Choose @mechanic{Surrender} at Junction 4.

guide.context: Both final Junction outcomes register in one run when the first is followed by an immediate checkpoint restart.

steps.text: At Junction 4, preview the outcomes and confirm @mechanic{Surrender}; wait for the achievement before pausing.
Select @mechanic{Restart from Last Checkpoint}, replay Junction 4, and confirm Control.

achievements.description: Sit a spell, take in Paul's presentation at the University.
achievements.summary: Sit through Paul Serene's complete Project Promenade presentation in Act 1, Part 1.

guide.context: The presentation is also the twelfth narrative object in the opening University section.

steps.text: After following Paul up the elevator, sit in the chair facing the large Project Promenade screen and remain seated until the presentation and achievement finish.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Casual Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete Quantum Break on Casual difficulty or any higher setting.

guide.context: Difficulty achievements stack, so finishing the campaign on Hard also awards the Casual and Normal completions.

steps.text: Set the campaign to Hard before Act 1, Part 1 and finish every story Part through Act 5 to unlock all three difficulty achievements together.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Normal Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete Quantum Break on Normal or Hard difficulty.

guide.context: A single Hard run is sufficient because lower-difficulty completion achievements stack.

steps.text: Keep the difficulty at Normal or Hard for every gameplay Part and defeat the final boss in Act 5.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Hard Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete every gameplay Part of Quantum Break on Hard difficulty.

guide.context: Timeline replays can retain a different difficulty than the main run, so verify Hard before each replayed Part; Junctions and episodes contain no scored combat.

steps.text: Set @mechanic{Hard} before starting Act 1, Part 1.
Keep Hard selected through every gameplay Part in Acts 1–5 and recheck the setting after any Timeline replay.
Defeat Paul Serene in Act 5, Part 3 and continue through the ending until the Hard completion unlock appears.

achievements.description: Watch a show episode with all of its Quantum Ripples unlocked.
achievements.summary: Trigger both Act 1 Quantum Ripples and watch Episode 1 without skipping it.

guide.context: The two required Act 1 Ripples are Formula Solution in Part 2 and Memento during Junction 1.

steps.text: In Act 1, Part 2, examine @item{Formula Solution} before leaving the laboratory route.
During Junction 1, examine @item{Memento} before confirming the Junction decision.
Play the complete Episode 1 live-action show after Junction 1 without skipping it, then continue into Act 2 if the unlock is delayed.

achievements.description: Upgrade a time power.
achievements.summary: Spend a Chronon Source to purchase one time-power upgrade.

guide.context: The first Chronon Source appears early in Act 2, and collected Sources persist through Timeline replays.

steps.text: Use Time Vision to reveal a nearby Chronon Source and collect it.
Open @mechanic{Time Powers}, select any available upgrade, and spend the required Chronon Source point.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade Time Stop or Time Dodge.
achievements.summary: Purchase every upgrade for either @mechanic{Time Stop} or @mechanic{Time Dodge}.

guide.context: Both powers are strong on Hard, making one of them an efficient first branch to complete.

steps.text: Collect Chronon Sources revealed by Time Vision while progressing through the campaign.
Open @mechanic{Time Powers} and purchase every node in the Time Stop branch or every node in the Time Dodge branch.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all time powers.
achievements.summary: Collect all 60 Chronon Sources and fully upgrade every time power.

guide.context: The Timeline shows the Chronon Source count for each Part; all 60 are needed to buy the complete upgrade tree.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Timeline} and replay every Part whose Chronon Source counter is incomplete, using Time Vision to reveal each Source.
Open @mechanic{Time Powers} and spend the collected points until every upgrade node for all six powers is purchased.
If the final purchase does not unlock the achievement immediately, select Restart from Last Checkpoint and continue playing until the completed upgrade state is checked again.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of the game. Find every hidden thing, make every choice. DO ALL THE THINGS.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% by finishing the story, completing the active Timeline's collectibles, fully upgrading every time power, and making both choices at all four Junctions.

guide.context: Narrative-object counts change with Junction decisions. Complete one consistent active Timeline before changing old Junctions through chapter replay.

steps.text: Complete the campaign and fill every Timeline counter for narrative objects, Quantum Ripples, Intel, and Chronon Sources under one consistent set of Junction choices.
Spend all 60 Chronon Sources to purchase every time-power upgrade.
Use Restart from Last Checkpoint during the main run, or replay Junctions afterward, until Hardline, PR, Business, Personal, Amaral, Hatch, Control, and Surrender have all registered.

achievements.description: Trigger all Quantum Ripples.
achievements.summary: Trigger all eight Quantum Ripples across Acts 1–4.

guide.context: Ripples add small changes to the live-action episodes; the Timeline records which Parts contain them.

steps.text: In Act 1, Part 2, examine the equations whiteboard before the laboratory point of no return to trigger Formula Solution. During Junction 1, inspect the ram statue on the metal crate to trigger Memento.
In Act 2, Part 1, access the laptop whose email is titled Monarch PR Plan. In Act 2, Part 2, examine the Riverport Rexes mascot sign in the office building before the Leaving Ground Zero exit.

In Act 3, Part 1, use the small laptop beside the computer streaming the speech to trigger Stream the Speech. In Act 3, Part 2, activate the tablet beside the radio at garage pillar B2 to trigger Audio Book.

In Act 4, Part 2, talk to Amy or Nick so they spread online misdirection and trigger Beth's Information. In Act 4, Part 4, interact with the circuit breaker box on the wall while following Beth across the rooftops to trigger Power Shutoff.
Open @mechanic{Timeline} and confirm that every Part containing a Quantum Ripple shows a complete counter.

achievements.description: Locate all Intel Items.
achievements.summary: Collect all nine Intel items in Acts 2, 3, and 5.

guide.context: Intel consists of character-linked objects rather than ordinary emails or documents, and each item has its own Timeline counter.

steps.text: Collect Eye Drop Bottle in Act 2, Part 1 and Sudden Stop in Act 2, Part 2.
Collect CFR Briefing and Brenner's Mug in Act 3, Part 1, then Fiona Cocktail Sword in Act 3, Part 2.
Collect Monarch Radio Note, Monarch Paperweight with Note, Reflections on the End, and Charlie's Badge in Act 5, Part 1.
Open @mechanic{Timeline} and confirm all nine Intel slots are filled.

achievements.description: Locate 1 Quantum Ripple and 1 Intel Item.
achievements.summary: Register at least one @item{Quantum Ripple} and one @item{Intel object} on the same save.

guide.context: The first reliable Intel is Eye Drop Bottle in Act 2, Part 1, after multiple earlier opportunities to trigger a Ripple.

steps.text: Trigger Formula Solution in Act 1, Part 2, Memento in Junction 1, or Monarch PR Plan early in Act 2, Part 1.
In Act 2, Part 1, pick up @item{Eye Drop Bottle} in the Ground Zero area to register the first Intel item.

achievements.description: Find all e-mails, presentations, TV shows, radios and posters.
achievements.summary: Collect every email, presentation, TV show, radio recording, and poster required by the active Timeline.

guide.context: The narrative-object total varies slightly with Junction choices; the per-Part Timeline counters, not a second choice path, define completion.

steps.text: Keep one consistent set of Junction decisions and use @mechanic{Timeline}, rather than New Game, to fill remaining collectible counters.
Collect every email, presentation, TV show, radio recording, poster, and other narrative object in all gameplay Parts from Act 1, Part 1 through Act 5, Part 3.
After each Part, open @mechanic{Timeline} and replay only Parts whose Narrative Objects counter is incomplete.
Fill every Narrative Objects counter shown for the active Timeline; alternate-path versions are not required.

achievements.description: Deflect a total of 200 bullets with the Time Shield.
achievements.summary: Deflect a cumulative 200 enemy bullets with @mechanic{Time Shield}.

guide.context: A larger upgraded shield can cover several firing enemies at once, accelerating the cumulative counter.

steps.text: During gunfights, cast Time Shield between Jack and a group of shooting enemies and remain behind its surface while incoming bullets are deflected.
Repeat with every combat group until the shield has deflected 200 bullets in total.
